usage: hypothesis_forge [-h] [--root ROOT] [--data-root DATA_ROOT]
                        {preflight,forge-input,forge-run,disposition-record,disposition-show,discovery-coverage,research-scope-resolve,episode-normalized-view,list-snapshot-register,discovery-binding,discovery-execute,discovery-preview,persist-draft,freeze,prospects,finalize,revise,classify,show-session,pending,prior,diagnostics,censoring-ignorability-diagnostic,selection-robustness-gate,backfill-legacy,prove-runtime,inventory-placeholder-times,apply-provenance-correction,rebase-science-memory,memory-policy-status,memory-policy-preview,memory-policy-apply,research-policy-status,research-policy-preview,research-policy-apply,universe-policy-status,universe-policy-preview,universe-policy-apply,operation-stop-preview,operation-stop,preview-reopened-prior-routing,vision-acceptance,commission-reopened-priors,repair-continuation-draft,repair-continuation-plan,repair-continuation-apply,repair-continuation-close} ...

positional arguments:
  {preflight,forge-input,forge-run,disposition-record,disposition-show,discovery-coverage,research-scope-resolve,episode-normalized-view,list-snapshot-register,discovery-binding,discovery-execute,discovery-preview,persist-draft,freeze,prospects,finalize,revise,classify,show-session,pending,prior,diagnostics,censoring-ignorability-diagnostic,selection-robustness-gate,backfill-legacy,prove-runtime,inventory-placeholder-times,apply-provenance-correction,rebase-science-memory,memory-policy-status,memory-policy-preview,memory-policy-apply,research-policy-status,research-policy-preview,research-policy-apply,universe-policy-status,universe-policy-preview,universe-policy-apply,operation-stop-preview,operation-stop,preview-reopened-prior-routing,vision-acceptance,commission-reopened-priors,repair-continuation-draft,repair-continuation-plan,repair-continuation-apply,repair-continuation-close}
    forge-input         No-write FORGE_INPUT_RECEIPT; never starts a session
    forge-run           Bounded representation-ladder run receipt; default no-
                        write
    disposition-record  Record one authored scientific assessment/withdrawal
                        (ORDINARY_SCIENTIFIC_DISPOSITION_V1). Without
                        --preview it appends to the ResearchStore: run it only
                        inside an authorized scope (see the contract). Advice
                        only: no look, budget, admission or session.
    disposition-show    Read recorded scientific assessments with
                        applicability and lineage; no outcome rows
    discovery-coverage  No-write state-only joint coverage. Never selects
                        typed_value.
    research-scope-resolve
                        Resolve list aliases of a draft query 1.2 to its
                        canonical scope; reads no market value.
    episode-normalized-view
                        Scope-bound NORMALIZED_TRAJECTORY_EPISODES_V1 prefix
                        view for an existing BASE session; reads no target.
    list-snapshot-register
                        Register one local membership snapshot; a manual list
                        is never available before registration.
    discovery-binding   No-write discovery admission binding from the
                        published corpus. Does not read parquet values.
    discovery-execute   Compute one BASE_X price/liquidity query from census
                        and observation rows into an explicit store. Does not
                        select the live store.
    discovery-preview   Feature-only temporal preview. Writes store memory
                        only when --store and --journal-scope are both set.
                        Does not read a target.
    persist-draft       Durably bind generated draft bytes to their source
                        preflight before freeze
    censoring-ignorability-diagnostic
                        offline X300 selection diagnostic; canonical LIVE
                        CORPUS via parent --data-root, or explicit parquet
                        paths which stay noncanonical
    selection-robustness-gate
                        offline two-stage selection gate; reuses Stage 1 then
                        optional Block-A logistic OOF-AUC; owner-facing field
                        is router_decision
    inventory-placeholder-times
                        read-only counts of HFIC records with placeholder
                        provenance times
    apply-provenance-correction
                        append-only HFIC provenance-time correction; requires
                        --confirm-append-only after merge phrase
    rebase-science-memory
                        append-only science-memory suppression rebase;
                        requires --confirm-append-only
    memory-policy-status
                        read-only HFIC search-memory policy and prior-memory
                        capacity
    memory-policy-preview
                        read-only preview of an append-only HFIC search-memory
                        policy
    memory-policy-apply
                        append-only HFIC search-memory policy; requires
                        --confirm-append-only
    research-policy-status
                        show the active research policy for new runs, and what
                        a given run or scope is frozen at; reads no market
                        values and writes nothing
    research-policy-preview
                        preview a change of the active defaults for new runs;
                        with --for-operation preview raising that exact run's
                        scopes instead. Reads no market values
    research-policy-apply
                        append one previewed change: either new active
                        defaults or the extension of exact scopes (the receipt
                        says which). Save the preview output as the proposal
                        file
    universe-policy-status
                        read the active Forge research-universe profile from
                        ResearchStore
    universe-policy-preview
                        preview holders and liquidity minima; optional
                        decision-point counts do not read outcomes
    universe-policy-apply
                        append one authorized research-universe activation
    operation-stop-preview
                        read-only proposal to stop one exact ordinary
                        operation; no verdict, no quota return
    operation-stop      append one owner stop of an ordinary operation;
                        requires --confirm-append-only
    preview-reopened-prior-routing
                        read-only CONTROL reconsideration preview after
                        planned legacy-prior commission and exact-session
                        quarantine
    vision-acceptance   read-only FORGE_VISION_ACCEPTANCE machine evidence
                        over suppression/priors/vision/packet/challenger
    commission-reopened-priors
                        append-only legacy reopenable prior HYPOTHESIS_VERSION
                        records; requires --confirm-append-only
    repair-continuation-draft
                        no-write draft builder from show-session; spent looks
                        default from journal
    repair-continuation-plan
                        no-write owner plan for repair continuation after
                        completed NO_WORTHY
    repair-continuation-apply
                        append-only repair continuation; requires --confirm-
                        append-only; separate from plan
    repair-continuation-close
                        append-only CLOSE after a new terminal; requires
                        --confirm-append-only

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT
  --data-root DATA_ROOT
                        factory data_root; for censoring-ignorability-
                        diagnostic and selection-robustness-gate this must be
                        an imported LIVE CORPUS
                        (datasets/live_lifecycle_corpus/lineage.json), never
                        Observation RDP

usage: hypothesis_forge preflight [-h] [--owner-focus OWNER_FOCUS]
                                  [--collection {LIVE_LIFECYCLE,OPPORTUNITY_EPISODES}]
                                  [--format {json}] [--no-auto-commission]
                                  [--additional-cycle]
                                  [--control-current-representation]
                                  [--discovery-contract]
                                  [--model-provenance-sha256 MODEL_PROVENANCE_SHA256]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --owner-focus OWNER_FOCUS
  --collection {LIVE_LIFECYCLE,OPPORTUNITY_EPISODES}
                        Evidence collection; OPPORTUNITY_EPISODES scopes the
                        focus to that corpus
  --format {json}
  --no-auto-commission
  --additional-cycle    Explicitly request the NEXT AUTO research cycle of
                        this market, or resume the pending one. Without it a
                        repeat returns the saved session. It starts a cycle
                        only while the market epoch's frozen AUTO pool allows
                        it (see research-policy-status)
  --control-current-representation
                        CURRENT_REPRESENTATION_CONTROL_V1 evidence-surface
                        mode
  --discovery-contract  Accepted on ordinary preflight. Non-CONTROL receipts
                        always carry FORGE_GROUNDED_DISCOVERY_V1; this flag
                        does not toggle it.
  --model-provenance-sha256 MODEL_PROVENANCE_SHA256
                        Caller-supplied model/reasoning provenance digest;
                        retained for reuse checks, not an attestation of the
                        model actually used

usage: hypothesis_forge forge-run [-h] [--format {json}]
                                  [--owner-focus OWNER_FOCUS]
                                  [--collection {LIVE_LIFECYCLE,OPPORTUNITY_EPISODES}]
                                  [--no-write] [--persist]
                                  [--saved-draft-sha256 SAVED_DRAFT_SHA256]
                                  [--model-provenance-sha256 MODEL_PROVENANCE_SHA256]
                                  [--control-current-representation]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {json}
  --owner-focus OWNER_FOCUS
  --collection {LIVE_LIFECYCLE,OPPORTUNITY_EPISODES}
  --no-write            Default; never persist the aggregate run
  --persist             Append FORGE_RUN_RECEIPT on an already-authorized
                        slash store
  --saved-draft-sha256 SAVED_DRAFT_SHA256
                        Resume the exact saved draft; do not regenerate
  --model-provenance-sha256 MODEL_PROVENANCE_SHA256
                        Optional caller-supplied model/reasoning provenance
                        for admission readback; mismatch blocks reuse and
                        never resets market budget
  --control-current-representation
                        Explicit CURRENT_REPRESENTATION_CONTROL_V1. Ordinary
                        forge-run does not imply it.
